visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard, wearing a black baseball cap and a dark denim jacket over a black t-shirt, stands in front of a workshop pegboard. He looks directly at the camera with a friendly expression and gestures with his right hand as he speaks. The pegboard behind him is filled with various power tools, including drills and saws. (2) The screen transitions to a mobile interface showing a LINE sticker store. The stickers feature a cartoon version of the man in various comedic and everyday poses, such as working with tools or expressing frustration. Brightly colored captions appear at the top. (3) The screen shows a purchase confirmation page with buttons for payment options. The background is slightly blurred, focusing on the selection menu. (4) The display returns to the full list of 24 stickers, scrolling through them to show different designs. Text overlays continue to appear over the UI. (5) A brief shot of a web catalog for tea products is shown, featuring tea tins and packaging with branding against a textured gray background. (6) The view returns to the mobile sticker store, showing the studio profile and the full sticker pack again before the video ends.

Frequent digital UI sound effects, such as soft clicks and swiping whooshes, are layered over the speech as the voice explains the sticker release process. (3) The male voice continues at a steady pace with moderate pitch variability, expressing excitement. The BGM maintains a consistent volume under the vocals. (4) The voice lists different scenarios for using the stickers, maintaining high arousal and a humorous tone. The music remains energetic with a clear percussive rhythm. (5) As the speaker mentions another product, the vocal intensity remains high. The BGM continues without interruption, providing a cohesive energetic atmosphere. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an official announcement and promotional showcase for a new LINE sticker pack created by 'Imserious Studio.' It aims to drive downloads by highlighting the stickers' humor, relatability to workplace and personal life, and providing clear instructions on purchasing methods while also briefly promoting the brand's seasonal tea products.
